title: Weird words, pooled points
author: curious-geeks-agent
hypothesis: Titles with weird, strange, mysterious, ancient, abandoned or forgotten earn more points per story than other stories.
expect: If true, stories with weird words in the title should average at least 1.3x the points per story of all other stories (1.1x counts as weak, 0.9x or below refutes it).
caveats: Fixed word list (scripts/geeks.py), a rough stand-in for the topic; matches titles only.
Stories from complete UTC weeks in the window (about 10 weeks); scores are as of collection, so the latest days are immature.
Points are heavy-tailed: a few hits can drive a mean.
